# Autolinks

Angle brackets: <https://example.com/path?q=1&r=2> and <me@example.com>.

Bare URLs: https://example.com/bare and http://example.com and https://example.com/a_b/c-d.

Trailing punctuation: https://example.com/a. Then https://example.com/b, then (https://example.com/c) and https://example.com/d).

Bare email: me@example.com and first.last+tag@example.co.jp.

Not links: example.com, localhost:8080, user@localhost.

In code: `https://example.com/code` stays text.
